encoding: UTF-8; CSV blank means missing, never implicit zero; gz files are ordinary gzip CSV

identities.curve_population: ordinary_manual; 177 images, frozen pool_id/reference_id/worker pool; N=pool_n
identities.classification_population: original history_eligible Manual, 5785 records/179 images; not the same population as curves
identities.heldout_building: ALL is descriptive all-history fit; all other folds exclude that building from training; team relabeling uses the team's held-out-building fold

methods.original_common: original feature definition refitted on common eligibility

identities.class_id: maximum-overlap aligned to original within fold; raw_class_id retains fitted order; unknown is not a fourth class

conditions.ref_turn5: reference effective turn count, excluding turns <=5 degrees; not historical raw point-pair count
conditions.ref_H: saved self-occlusion measure under the declared solid-wall footprint; not furniture occlusion
conditions.ref_short_edges: saved count of edges shorter than 4% of perimeter with both endpoint turns >=15 degrees
conditions.ref_min_horizontal_deg: saved minimum horizontal angular span, degrees
conditions.structure_group: H_positive takes priority over short_H0; plain_H0 has H=0 and no short edge
conditions.challenge: ref_turn5>6 OR ref_H>0 OR ref_short_edges>0; plain is complement; not a replacement difficulty label
conditions.scope: all, turn_band, mechanism or exact reference turn count; groups overlap across scopes, never sum them as disjoint populations

curve_fields.capacity: fixed candidate support N>=30 or N>=35, then metric-specific complete curve
curve_fields.point: k as string or full for actual N; k2 is deferred and retained only in source rows
curve_fields.common_curve: all required points have a finite saved value for this image/metric; missing_points lists excluded points
curve_fields.Q_mean: saved mean Q on valid quality support, not failure-filled quality
curve_fields.Q_sd_display: saved exact finite-population SD or path sample SD according to source estimator; do not replace missing by zero
curve_fields.actual_consensus_failure_rate: saved actual execution failure rate; [0,1], not all unscoreable states
curve_fields.output_unscoreable_rate: saved output unscoreable rate, distinct from actual failure
curve_fields.V_metrics: V_floor,V_centroid_h,V_height_h,V_turn5,V_nodes: saved pure-geometry pooled256 mean with original attempted/valid pair counts; no new exact V computation or conversion of its units
curve_fields.image_equal: equal mean over fixed eligible image values
curve_fields.building_equal: first images equally within building, then buildings equally
curve_fields.delta: later marginal estimate minus earlier for the same image; not path-paired individual effect
curve_fields.positive_images_negative_images: counts using delta tolerance 1e-10; analogous counts for building averages
curve_fields.spearman: descriptive rank correlation with per-image 6->30 marginal change; no covariate adjustment, significance selection or new prediction claim
curve_fields.source_columns: CURVE_SOURCE_ROWS and GEOMETRY_SOURCE_ROWS preserve all original fields, including estimators, exact_kind, attempts, valid units, counts and uncertainty; no recomputation or sampled-team deduplication

classification_fields.a_c_p: all, challenge, plain; means first across records within worker/building, then buildings equally
classification_fields.native_eligibility: original frozen manual_geometry; overall >=12 images/3 buildings; geometry additionally plain>=5/2 and challenge>=4/2
classification_fields.common: intersection of native eligibility and finite required features; fitting comparisons use same workers
classification_fields.changed: aligned label differs from published label on common support
classification_fields.ARI: adjusted Rand index of partition vs published, not prediction accuracy
classification_fields.CLASS_CENTERS: means of original-unit history features and complete members; no Q/T center used to select classes
classification_fields.TRANSFORMS: original robust transformation/PCA parameters and per-fold reporting alignment

composition_fields.configuration: C1|C2|C3 counts for all members of the actual team, including fixed background
composition_fields.valid: finite metric outcomes in that panel; failures remain missing and are not zero
composition_fields.total: population variance E[(Y-EY)^2] over valid team occurrences
composition_fields.between: population variance of configuration conditional means, weighted by occurrence counts
composition_fields.between_share: between/total after panel->image->building equal aggregation of variances; not mean panel shares or predictive R2
composition_fields.common_panel: all background/candidate members known under every compared definition; original links and every 924 teams retained

ABC_fields.identity: stage+event_id; phase/source_class/target_class/n/m remain original design and must not be pooled as independent observations
ABC_fields.legal: X,Y pure known same class, Z pure known different class; fixed D and disjoint actual members validated
ABC_fields.reason: strict_ABC, mixed_block, unknown_block_member, XY_different_class or Z_same_class
ABC_fields.unknown_D: unknown labels in fixed background, recorded but not a new eligibility gate
ABC_fields.scored: original ABC_scored and all A/B/C Q finite; independent of legality
ABC_fields.CB: C_Q-B_Q on ABC-complete common metric support; not historical standalone CB support
ABC_fields.common_legal: same frozen event legal under all definitions; its outcome metrics necessarily identical across methods
ABC_fields.frozen_primary_role: original-fold largest class -> original-fold highest m_hard_turn_n class, source distinct from target; retains original n18/m7 confirm headline
ABC_fields.aggregation: equal background_target_n levels within block, equal blocks within image; then image equal or equal images within building followed by building equal
ABC_fields.own_legal: method-specific remaining events; different populations prohibit ranking method effectiveness by means
ABC_fields.events: scored legal event count for the stated support; neither independent people nor independent images

boundaries: No new scoring, fusion or arrival paths
Author checks are not independent acceptance
